question: Do the recovered controller, governor, token-settlement and successful post-fix turn establish the BUDGETS_ENFORCED acceptance criterion?

verification.scope: SkatAI bounded controller and governor enforcement; no independent OpenAI account or project billing hard ceiling has been verified.
verification.incident: The 2026-09-25 incident recorded 2999 model requests, 335157288 input tokens, 1045759 output tokens and $42.23721065 cost; idle-driven resubmission and commit-sensitive progress contributed.
verification.governor: Idle-triggered submits are forbidden. Hard caps are 10 submits/day, 2500000 tokens/day, 250000-token reservation/turn and $7 incident-cost proxy/day; autonomous caps are 8 submits/day and $5 proxy/day. Explicit user input cannot bypass hard totals.
verification.settlement: Accepted turn-closure recovery reconciled 512351 actual tokens from three cancelled sessions and cleared 750000 stale reserved tokens without inference; actual usage settles reservations and missing usage takes a conservative fail-closed reservation fallback.
verification.post_fix: Recovery evidence verifies terminal-outcome grace, no-idle-submit behavior, bounded controller enforcement and a successful post-fix turn.

decision: ACCEPT controller-level BUDGETS_ENFORCED. This does not claim an independently verified OpenAI account/project billing hard ceiling or sustained FULL-AFK success.
